config.label: Base URL of the Store Builder API
config.description: Base URL of the Store Builder API. Defaults to http://localhost:8080.

config.label: An API key from the store's Agent app (Apps → AI agent → Create key)
config.description: An API key from the store's Agent app (Apps → AI agent → Create key). Opens both the partner API and the private site API for that one store.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. A platform account, only for account-level calls a key cannot make (listing sites, members, roles).
